title: 1,600 sacks of 'illegal' mineral ores seized in Dipolog port

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Authorities seized nearly 1,600 sacks of mineral ores sourced from alleged illegal mining activities at a declared “minahang bayan” (people’s small-scale mining area) in Zamboanga del Sur on Saturday, Sept. 26. Three wing van trucks loaded with mineral ores were intercepted Thursday evening at the Dipolog City Port, Zamboanga del Norte, as the vehicles were bound for Cebu City in the Visayas. The trucks were impounded and opened on Saturday after negotiations with the shipper. Engr.
